# RadiusPilot

> RadiusPilot scans any neighbourhood for real businesses, scores each one on its website and listing, and helps marketing agencies pitch them.

RadiusPilot is a Windows app and a web app for marketing agencies and freelancers. A scan lists the real businesses of an area from public listings; each business gets an opportunity score from what its web presence is missing (no website, no HTTPS, no online booking, incomplete listing details), and the app drafts outreach, reports and websites from those facts. Ratings and reviews are never invented. Every outreach email carries an unsubscribe line, with a daily limit and an opt-out list (Canada’s anti-spam law, CASL). The Windows version is a test version that has not yet run on a real Windows computer; payments are not live.

## Product
- [Product](https://radiuspilot.com/product/): From the first scan to the signed client: scans, scores, outreach, AI Builder drafts, pipeline and reports in one app, on Windows or in your browser.
- [Tools](https://radiuspilot.com/tools/): A website audit and eight tools in RadiusPilot: site speed, email health, site technology, published contacts, site history, QR codes, brand kits, posts.
- [Email check: SPF, DKIM and DMARC](https://radiuspilot.com/email-check/): Check any domain’s MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC records in a few seconds, in your browser: see whether a business can receive email and whether anyone can fake it.
- [Solutions](https://radiuspilot.com/solutions/): How web design studios, local SEO agencies, ads and social agencies and freelance marketers find and win local clients with RadiusPilot.
- [Pricing](https://radiuspilot.com/pricing/): Start on Starter at $0 with 25 credits, upgrade when it pays. Compare Starter, Pro and Agency, their credits and the credit packs. Payments aren’t live yet.
- [Developers: the RadiusPilot API](https://radiuspilot.com/developers/): The RadiusPilot API, in beta: search an area’s businesses with their opportunity scores, check a website and draft outreach with RadiusPilot AI, billed in credits.
- [Download](https://radiuspilot.com/download/): Download the RadiusPilot test version for Windows 10 and 11: a zip with the app, nothing to install, with its SHA-256 checksum to check the file.
- [Web app](https://radiuspilot.com/web/): Use RadiusPilot in your browser. Your account and data stay on your device.
- [Live demo](https://radiuspilot.com/demo/): Try the real RadiusPilot app in your browser on a demo workspace: scans, opportunity scores, outreach drafts and reports, with nothing to install.
- [Beta access](https://radiuspilot.com/beta/): Request early access to the RadiusPilot website builder, with RadiusPilot AI included in the beta and a direct line to the team.
- [Security and data](https://radiuspilot.com/security/): Where RadiusPilot keeps your data, how passwords and mailboxes are protected, and what leaves your computer.

## Guides
- [What is a good PageSpeed Insights score?](https://radiuspilot.com/guides/good-pagespeed-insights-score/): A Performance score of 90 to 100 is good. What the bands mean, why the score is a lab test, why it moves between runs, and what Google actually measures.
- [Website audit checklist for pitching a small business](https://radiuspilot.com/guides/website-audit-checklist/): Ten checks to run on a small business’s website before you pitch: what to look at, how to verify it by hand, and how to turn one finding into a fair email.
- [How to find local businesses that need a new website](https://radiuspilot.com/guides/find-local-businesses-that-need-a-website/): A step-by-step method for agencies and freelancers: list one neighbourhood’s businesses, check each website, score the gaps and pitch one real fact.
- [Cold email in Canada: what CASL requires of agencies](https://radiuspilot.com/guides/casl-cold-email-canada/): What Canada’s anti-spam law asks before an agency emails a local business: consent, published addresses, sender details, unsubscribes, records and penalties.
- [SPF, DKIM and DMARC explained for agency owners](https://radiuspilot.com/guides/spf-dkim-dmarc-explained/): What SPF, DKIM and DMARC do, how to check any domain’s records, what Google and Yahoo require, and how to turn a weak result into a fair first email.

## Help center
- [Install RadiusPilot on Windows](https://radiuspilot.com/help/install/): What you need, how to open the app from the zip, and what to do if Windows warns you.
- [Your first scan](https://radiuspilot.com/help/first-scan/): Find real businesses around any address in five steps, and see what Starter’s preview scan shows.
- [Real data, and the live demo](https://radiuspilot.com/help/demo-data/): Everything in your account is real. The invented demo workspace lives only in the live demo on this website.
- [Use RadiusPilot in your browser](https://radiuspilot.com/help/web-app/): The web app: what runs in a browser, what needs the Windows app, where your data lives and how to move it.
- [Keyboard shortcuts](https://radiuspilot.com/help/shortcuts/): Every keyboard shortcut in RadiusPilot: searching, new scans, jumping between pages, the business lists, mail and call mode. Press ? in the app to see them.
- [Where the businesses come from](https://radiuspilot.com/help/business-data/): What a real scan finds, why coverage varies, and why some fields stay empty.
- [Reading ScopeMap](https://radiuspilot.com/help/scopemap/): Every business from your scans on one map, coloured by opportunity or by category.
- [How the opportunity score works](https://radiuspilot.com/help/opportunity-score/): What the score weighs for real businesses, and what High, Medium and Low mean.
- [What the website checks look at](https://radiuspilot.com/help/website-checks/): During a scan, the Windows app opens each homepage once and notes a few facts. A website audit checks much more.
- [Connect your mailbox](https://radiuspilot.com/help/connect-mailbox/): Send and receive from your own address in the Windows app. Your password stays encrypted on your computer.
- [Email rules: CASL and CAN-SPAM](https://radiuspilot.com/help/email-rules/): What RadiusPilot adds to help you follow anti-spam law, and what stays your job.
- [Sequences, follow-ups and automations](https://radiuspilot.com/help/sequences/): Sequences plan your follow-ups and wait for you. Automations run the steps you choose.
- [AI Builder drafts](https://radiuspilot.com/help/ai-builder/): Websites, pitch decks, market reports and lead lists, drafted from what a scan found, then edited in the website editor.
- [Reports and white-label](https://radiuspilot.com/help/reports/): Market reports with up to nine sections, saved as PDF, in your own colours on the Agency plan.
- [Published contacts and the law](https://radiuspilot.com/help/published-contacts/): What the tool reads, what it never does, and how it keeps the source of an address you use.
- [Your RadiusPilot account](https://radiuspilot.com/help/website-account/): Create an account on this website with your email and a password, keep it secure, follow support tickets, and export or delete your data.
- [Two-step verification and backup codes](https://radiuspilot.com/help/two-step/): Add an authenticator code to your sign-in in the app, keep backup codes in case you lose your phone, and lock the app when you step away.
- [Where your data lives, and how to remove it](https://radiuspilot.com/help/your-data/): Your workspace stays on your computer, or in your browser for the web app. What leaves it, how to back it up, and how to delete it.
- [Plans and billing](https://radiuspilot.com/help/plans-and-billing/): The three plans and the credits they include, how scans are counted, and why payments aren’t live yet.
- [Credits and pay as you go](https://radiuspilot.com/help/credits/): What uses credits and what never does, what each plan includes, the credit packs, and what happens when you run out.
- [The RadiusPilot API](https://radiuspilot.com/help/api/): What the API does, how to join its beta and get a key, what each request costs in credits, and the rules for what it returns.
